```{r}
library(data.table)
psiTable <- fread("/Users/mikej/Documents/Career/Georges/Ule/projects/PSI_TABLE-hg38.tab.gz")

# Create table containing only IR events, merge with summary statistics for exploration
stau2 <- psiTable[grep("^STAU2", psiTable$GENE), ]               
rownames(stau2) <- stau2$EVENT
rn <- rownames(stau2)

write.table(stau2, file = "stau2.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

```
